stem: In a circle, ∠A = $60^\circ$ faces arc BCD, and arc BAD is the rest of the circle. Set the arc so that it shows $m(\text{arc } BAD)$.
solution: ∠A = 60° faces arc BCD, so m(arc BCD) = 120°.

hints.text: First find the arc the given angle faces; remember an arc is double its inscribed angle.
The two arcs BCD and BAD together make the whole circle; check which one you have set.
Find arc BCD first, then use the fact that the two arcs complete 360°.

notes: Book answer 240. Original stem is truncated; the givens are taken from part 1's figure.
